SUBJECT:

Declining of offer of right shares offered by Zameen Venture One (Private)
Limited ("Company")

I, Zeeshan Ali Khan bearing CNIC no. 35201-6487663-3 do hereby acknowledge as under:
1. I am a member of the Company.
2. I am aware that the Company intends to increase its paid-up capital by issuing 99,802,556
ordinary shares ("Shares") to the existing shareholders of the Company, in proportion to
their existing shareholding, subject to increase of authorised share capital.
3. The Company has offered me Shares vide letter of offer for right shares dated 18 March
2019, however, I am declining this offer.
4. Whatever has been stated above is true to the best of my knowledge and belief.

Zeeshan Ali Khan
Director
